_about: Prices typed in from each shop's official price sheet (Manekineko PDF, Karaoke-kan images) (not crawled). Refresh by hand: the weekly job warns when an entry is older than 90 days. 'images': the price images and their SHA-1; the Karaoke-kan crawl warns when one changes.
